## Workload

Lena Fischer completed the grading workload during 384 rostered hours. In total, 812 reads were completed, representing an average of 2.1 per hour. This output provides a clear account of the activity undertaken during the review period and records both the overall volume and the associated hourly rate.

The workload was managed consistently, with the recorded activity supporting the reported average of 2.1 per hour. No further qualification of the workload was identified in the review material.

## Quality

A sample of 61 reads was checked again. The agreement result was 60.7 per cent. Feedback was provided on borderline background cases to support consistent grading and clarify the application of the review standard.

The work was reviewed by Priya Anand. The review considered the checked sample and the reported agreement result alongside the overall grading activity completed by Lena Fischer.
